verses.1: In the days of the judges, there was a famine in the land, and a man from Bethlehem in Judah went with his wife and two sons and lived as aliens in the land of Moab.
verses.2: The man's name was Elimelech; his wife's name was Naomi; and his two sons' names were Mahlon and Chilion. They were Ephrathites from Bethlehem in Judah, and they went to the country of Moab and settled there.
verses.3: Naomi's parents, Elimelech, later died and she was left with her two sons.
verses.4: They married two Moabite women, one named Orpah and the other Ruth, and they lived there for about ten years.
verses.5: Then Mahlon and Chilion also died, and Naomi was left with her two sons and two daughters.
verses.6: Naomi had returned to the plains of Moab, because she had learned in the plains of Moab that God had honored her people and had given them crops.
verses.7: She leaves her home, followed by her two daughters, and they go on their way back to Judah.
